propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() spans 408 lines (59% of runner.py) and must be decomposed along functional seams to reduce file and method complexity.

ProviderSession is constructed at line 301 but its try-guard starts at line 474, causing httpx.AsyncClient leak when lines 301-473 raise; existing __enter__/__exit__ at providers.py:295-299 are unused.

Three child extractions (interpret_failure, build_model_settings/build_usage_limits, session guard) must each independently leave runner.py under 700 LOC when stacked, since CI verifies per-patchset and red ancestors block entire relation chains.

The extraction of build_model_settings must not relocate _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutations outside run() because structured_run is a leaf module with enforced no-runtime-import-from-runner invariant.
Six monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) targets move with their definitions; each child owning a relocated name must repoint all patches of that name in the same commit and document the reason.
